title: Prestarted enclave gateway cannot resolve the private enclave service after network attachment
symptoms: Enclave regression stops at gateway attachment before the agent starts
Smoke enclave job times out because the gateway cannot resolve awf-enclave-mcp
Host preflight gateway-attachment fails at network-membership
conditions: The compiler-launched mcpg container started on Docker's default bridge and AWF later attached it to the private awf-enclave-mcp-control network
The gateway resolver does not use Docker's private-network service discovery, so AWF validates exact network membership and writes the awf-enclave-mcp alias into the gateway's /etc/hosts
Older code used sed -i, which renames over Docker's bind-mounted /etc/hosts and fails; the current code rewrites the existing inode
A failed mapping is fail-closed and detaches the gateway; it is distinct from a retryable 503 backend_unavailable
rootCause: The prestarted gateway's resolver cannot see the AWF-created private network alias, and the first hosts-file update could not replace Docker's bind-mounted /etc/hosts. Without the alias, initialize could not reach the enclave MCP server.

probe.expect: Find the gateway-attachment preflight and the phase that failed (contract, identity, network-connect or network-membership). A network-membership failure with the resolution message points here; an absent record is unknown, not success. Do not read container environments.

action: Use AWF source that validates exact control-network membership and an IPv4 server address, then rewrites the gateway hosts entry in place, keeping identity checks and disconnect-on-failure. Do not widen the network, skip membership validation or extend timeouts. Hosted acceptance remains separate.
